description: Content hashes and provenance for the shot-allocation studies. Every JSON record is hashed individually in the SHA256SUMS file inside its own directory; the aggregate below is the SHA-256 of those per-file digests in sorted filename order.

provenance.note: Runs were executed on a shared 40-core node, single-threaded per job with parallelism across processes only, so no run can perturb another. Every job seeds its own generator; see the `seed` field in each record.
